name: Mark Mortimore
prior_offices: Hot Springs County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Mark Mortimore is the Hot Springs County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The official 2026 general election results list him as the winner of the coroner race.
